scope: VG-SAE idea-discovery literature completion; no active wiki
dedup_policy: DOI or proceedings ID when verified, otherwise arXiv ID; OpenReview forum/hash dedup; related 2017 dropout technical reports not double-counted
limitations: Search is broad but not a completeness proof.
Most papers have abstract-level review; direct overlapping equations read as marked.
Zotero/Obsidian unavailable in tool inventory; no connected private libraries searched.
Standard papers/ and literature/ contributed no PDFs; project refs/ supplied three relevant PDFs via prior shard.
OpenReview forum/API blocked; anonymous authors and decisions remain unverified.
Google Scholar/Semantic Scholar were reachable only via indexed web search, not authenticated database export.
Current arXiv author list for SAEBench includes Demian Till, unlike older search snippet; current metadata retained.
